purpose: Inherited ordinary instance factory calls parent::protected nonstatic Generator body. Two fresh same-class receivers remain distinct; the actual paused Generator closes and releases only its own $this while the sibling stays fresh.
source:
<?php
class Base77A {
    protected function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this instanceof Leaf77A), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf77A'), '|';
        try {
            yield 77;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP|'; }
}
class Mid77A extends Base77A {
    public function make() { echo 'MAKE|'; return parent::body(); }
}
class Leaf77A extends Mid77A {}
$a = new Leaf77A();
$b = new Leaf77A();
$wa = WeakReference::create($a);
$wb = WeakReference::create($b);
$g = $a->make();
$other = $b->make();
unset($a, $b);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($wa->get() !== null), '|', (int) ($wb->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'CURRENT|', (int) ($g->current() === 77), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($wa->get() === null), '|', (int) ($wb->get() !== null), '|';
unset($other, $wa, $wb);
echo 'E';

purpose: Ordinary instance root enters finite static/parent/self/parent keyword chain, all with one real receiver. Leaf override and Base body keep called Leaf after factory return; completed Generator releases its receiver while its return remains queryable.

    protected function body($item) {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this instanceof Leaf77B), '|',
             (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base77B'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf77B'), '|';
        yield $item;
        return 77;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP|'; }
}
class Mid77B extends Base77B {
    public function make($item) { echo 'MAKE|'; return static::middle($item); }
    protected function middle($item) { echo 'MID|'; return self::step($item); }
    protected function step($item) { echo 'STEP|'; return parent::body($item); }
}
class Leaf77B extends Mid77B {
    protected function middle($item) { echo 'LEAF|'; return parent::middle($item); }
}
$maker = new Leaf77B();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$input = 5;
$g = $maker->make($input);
unset($maker);

echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$value = $g->current();

     (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';

purpose: Fresh receiver-bearing keyword Generator THROW suspends before first yield in a Fiber, retains the actual receiver through pause, catches the supplied Exception at the first yield and releases This before outside return.

<?php
class Base77C {
    protected function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this instanceof Leaf77C), '|';
        Fiber::suspend('before77');
        try {
            yield 1;
            echo 'BAD|';
        } catch (Exception $caught) {
            echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught->getMessage() === 'given77'), '|';
        }
        return 77;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP|'; }
}
class Leaf77C extends Base77C {
    public function make() { echo 'MAKE|'; return self::body(); }
}
function Run77C() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $result = $g->throw(new Exception('given77'));
    echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($result === null), '|',
         (int) ($g->getReturn() === 77), '|';
    return 'fiber77';
}
$owner = new Leaf77C();
$weak = WeakReference::create($owner);
$g = $owner->make();
unset($owner);
$f = new Fiber('Run77C');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before77'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'DONE|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber77'), '|',
     (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: Independent inherited instance factory and private self bridge select a protected reference Generator body on the same This. Fresh SEND, supplied Fiber abort and cache replacement preserve actual receiver and payload lifetimes; the native actual CLOSED|0|1 corrects one provisional expected bit.
source:
<?php
class Payload77 { public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Base77 {
    protected function &body(&$item) {
        global $weakMaker, $weakPayload;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base77'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf77'), '|',
             (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        try {
            Fiber::suspend('fresh77');
            $received = yield $item;
            Fiber::suspend('cached77');
            echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|',
                 (int) ($received === 13), '|',
                 (int) ($item === $weakPayload->get()), '|';
        }
    }
}
class Mid77 extends Base77 {
    public function make(&$item) { echo 'MAKE|'; return self::bridge($item); }
    private function bridge(&$item) { echo 'BRIDGE|'; return parent::body($item); }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf77 extends Mid77 {
    public function bridge(&$item) { echo 'BAD-LEAF|'; return null; }
}
function Run77() {
    global $g, $stop, $weakMaker, $weakPayload;
    echo 'CALL|';
    try { $g->send(13); echo 'BAD-SEND|'; }
    catch (Throwable $caught) {
        echo 'OUT|', (int) ($caught === $stop), '|',
             (int) ($caught->getPrevious() === null), '|',
             (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|',
             (int) ($weakPayload->get() !== null), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber77';
}
$item = new Payload77();
$old =& $item;
$weakPayload = WeakReference::create($item);
$maker = new Leaf77();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$g = $maker->make($item);
unset($maker);
echo 'KEPT|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() !== null), '|';
$replacement = 9;
$item =& $replacement;
$f = new Fiber('Run77');
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($f->start() === 'fresh77'), '|';
echo 'NEXT|', (int) ($f->resume() === 'cached77'), '|';
echo 'CHANGE|';
$old = new Payload77();
$weakPayload = WeakReference::create($old);
unset($old);
echo 'CACHE|', (int) ($g->current() === $weakPayload->get()), '|',
     (int) ($item === 9), '|';
$stop = new Exception('stop77');
echo 'ABORT|', (int) ($f->throw($stop) === null), '|';
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->current() === $weakPayload->get()), '|',
     (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber77'), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'DROP|', (int) ($weakPayload->get() === null), '|E';
